The '''''Sojourner''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that [[Theron Shan]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], used during his [[mission to the Vesla system]].
